example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

GLTransaction.title: GL Transaction
GLTransaction.description: General ledger posting header. Owns the balanced set of GL lines and the posting lifecycle (draft → posted → reversed).

transactionNumber.description: Sequential transaction number unique per administration and fiscal year.

postingDate.description: Effective accounting date of the posting.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod record (T3); stub string acceptable until T3 is implemented.

currency.description: The administration's base currency for this posting (ISO 4217).

sourceReference.description: External document number (invoice no., bank statement ref, asset repair ID, etc.).

state.description: Lifecycle state of the GL transaction.

journalEntryId.description: Back-reference to the JournalEntry that materialised this posting, if any.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning the posting.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Transaction being composed; lines may be added and modified.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Balanced and locked; no further edits permitted. Balance invariant checked on entry.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Fully reversed by a counter-posting; retained for audit trail.

post.label: Post transaction
post.description: Lock the transaction after balance check. Requires sum(debit baseCurrencyAmount) = sum(credit baseCurrencyAmount).

reverse.label: Reverse transaction
reverse.description: Generate counter-posting and mark this transaction reversed.

GLLine.title: GL Line
GLLine.description: General ledger posting line. Carries both the transaction-currency amount and the base-currency presentation amount (multi-currency extension per bookkeeping-multi-currency T4 spec). Single-currency postings default fxRate=1.0 and baseCurrencyAmount=amount.

side.description: Debit or credit — encodes sign so amounts are always non-negative.

amount.description: The amount in the transaction currency (transactionAmount). Non-negative; on-the-wire JSON property name 'amount' preserved for T1 backwards compat — semantically this is transactionAmount.

transactionCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the line was posted in (renamed from T1 'currency'). Defaults to the administration's baseCurrency for same-currency postings.

baseCurrencyAmount.description: Amount converted to the administration's base currency at fxRate. Always present; trial balance and statements aggregate this field. baseCurrencyAmount = amount × fxRate.

baseCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of the administration's base currency at posting time.

fxRate.description: Rate converting one unit of transactionCurrency to baseCurrency units. Orientation: 1 transactionCurrency = fxRate × baseCurrency. Same orientation as FxRate.rate — no reciprocation. Defaults to 1.0 when transactionCurrency = baseCurrency.

fxRateSource.description: Origin of the FX rate used on this line.

fxRateDate.description: Date the FX rate applies to (typically the posting date or the preceding business day).

periodId.description: FK to FiscalPeriod; auto-resolved at post transition against postingDate and the active FiscalPeriod.

subLedgerType.description: Sub-ledger classification; T2 owns the actual sub-ledger registers.

subLedgerRef.description: FK into the sub-ledger when subLedgerType ≠ none.

costCenter.description: Cost-center / department code for allocation reporting.

isBaseCurrency.description: True when the line is posted in the administration's own base currency (fxRate=1.0 case).

gainLossIndicator.description: Difference between base-currency amount and transaction amount; non-zero signals FX conversion was applied.

transaction.description: Parent GL transaction that owns this line.

fxRateRecord.description: Join to the FxRate register on (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, date, source) — verifiable that fxRate = FxRate.rate with no reciprocation.

FxRate.title: FX Rate
FxRate.description: Foreign exchange rate for a (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, date, source) tuple. Orientation: 1 transactionCurrency = rate × baseCurrency, matching GLLine.fxRate — no reciprocation needed. ECB rates are stored inverted (our rate = 1 / ECB published rate) per REQ-MC-002.

transactionCurrency.description: The currency being converted FROM (the foreign/quote currency on a GL line). ISO 4217.

baseCurrency.description: The currency being converted TO (the administration's base currency). ISO 4217.

date.description: The day this rate applies to.

rate.description: Rate: 1 transactionCurrency = rate × baseCurrency. Same orientation as GLLine.fxRate. A USD/EUR row for '1 USD = 0.9259 EUR' stores rate: 0.9259. ECB feed inverted on ingest: our rate = 1 / ECB rate, rounded to ≥6 decimal places.

manualOverrideReason.description: Required when source = manual. Explains the business reason for overriding the ECB rate (e.g. internal hedge contract).

administrationId.description: Optional — when set, this rate applies only to the specified administration; when null the rate is global.

conditions.error: manualOverrideReason is required when source is manual

active.label: Active
active.description: Rate is valid and may be used for new GL postings.

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.description: A newer rate for the same tuple has been stored; this rate is retained for audit trail.

supersede.label: Supersede
supersede.description: Mark this rate as superseded when a corrected rate is stored for the same tuple.

countBySource.description: Number of FX rate records per source (ecb, manual, internal-policy).

latestRatePerPair.description: Most recent rate date per (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency) pair.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

ecb-fx-rate-ingestion.name: ECB Daily FX Rate Ingestion
ecb-fx-rate-ingestion.description: Fetches the ECB reference XML feed via openconnector source 'ecb-fx-rates', inverts each published rate (our rate = 1 / ECB rate), rounds to ≥6 decimal places, and upserts FxRate records with source: ecb. Emits a CloudEvent on completion. Per REQ-MC-003 and ADR-031 path 2.

period-end-fx-revaluation.name: Period-End FX Revaluation
period-end-fx-revaluation.description: Reads each open foreign-currency position (AR/AP with baseCurrencyAmount computed at book rate), computes the difference between book rate and the period-end ECB rate, and emits one balanced GLTransaction per position posting unrealised gain or loss to the configured account. Triggered on period close. Per REQ-MC-004 and ADR-031 path 2.

ias21-consolidation-translation.name: IAS 21 Functional-Currency Consolidation Translation
ias21-consolidation-translation.description: Translates per-subsidiary financial statements to the parent's presentation currency per IAS 21 rules: monetary assets/liabilities at closing rate, equity at historical rate, P&L at average rate. The resulting cumulative translation adjustment (CTA) posts to a dedicated equity account on the consolidated balance sheet. References the FxRate register for rate lookups. No PHP ConsolidationTranslationService. Per REQ-MC-005 and ADR-022.

rules.description: Monetary assets translated at period closing rate per IAS 21.23(a).
Monetary liabilities translated at period closing rate per IAS 21.23(a).
Equity translated at historical rate (rate at date of original transaction) per IAS 21.23(b).
Income and expenses translated at average rate for the period per IAS 21.22.
Income and expenses translated at average rate for the period per IAS 21.22.
